
### DHCPv6  {.smaller}


* IPv6 version of DHCP is DHCPv6 

   * not actual that common (we'll talk in a bit)

* kinda looks like DHCP done with hindsight: 
<hr class="vspace" />
* new protocol (not BOOTP extension)
* uses multicast instead of broadcast address 

   * so switches, hosts can filter DHCP traffic more easily

* more explicit relay support
* improved separation of message types 

   * separate RENEW and REQUEST messages
